cast.name: Batman
cast.wardrobe: Dark grey/black armored batsuit, scalloped cape, cowl with short ears, black bat emblem on chest, yellow-trimmed utility belt, finned gauntlets. Tier 6: same suit massively strained — seams splitting, gauntlet fins popped, cape half-torn, plates stretched over hypertrophied muscle. Coverage held (L33).

cast.name: Nightwing
cast.wardrobe: Black tactical suit with blue bird emblem sweeping across chest and shoulders, blue-striped gauntlets, escrima sticks at hips, black domino mask. Tier 6: suit bursting at seams, sleeves split, blue emblem stretched over a huge frame. Coverage held (L33).

cast.name: Killer Croc
cast.wardrobe: Hulking reptilian brute, green scaled hide, jagged teeth, ragged tactical trousers, heavy boots, bare torso. Already titan-sized (tier 6) from the Titan serum.

cast.name: Scarecrow
cast.wardrobe: Burlap sack mask with stitched mouth, tattered long coat over leather straps, fear-toxin gauntlet loaded with green vials. Titan-sized, hypermuscular (tier 6).

cast.name: Joker
cast.wardrobe: Torn purple tailcoat, green slicked-back hair, chalk-white skin, wide red grin. Titan-sized hypermuscular build straining the coat (tier 6).

cast.name: Bane
cast.wardrobe: Black-and-grey luchador mask, Venom/Titan tubes feeding into skull and spine glowing green, ragged cargo pants, heavy weight belt. Titan-sized (tier 6).

props.description: Batman's experimental serum — a slim chrome auto-injector with a glowing amber/gold vial, distinct from the villains' green Titan serum.
Batman's batmobile — low matte-black armored vehicle, DAZ3D render style.

locations.description: Arkham intake/cell wing during the breakout: blown-open cell doors, flickering red alarm strobes, drifting smoke, scattered gurneys, green Titan-serum haze.
Batcave control room: curved monitor array, command chair, raw cave-rock walls, cool blue under-lighting, the batmobile turntable off to one side.
Rain-slick Gotham street at night, neon glow, bridge leading to the burning Arkham island silhouette.
Arkham Asylum gothic facade engulfed in flames at night, broken front doors, smoke against a full moon, courtyard steps.
Arkham grand lobby / decayed grand hall: marble grand staircase, vaulted glass ceiling, stone columns, now smoke-filled and lit orange by fire glow.

panels.action: Arkham's intake wing mid-breakout: cell doors blown off their hinges, red alarm strobes flashing. The four villains — Croc, Scarecrow, Joker, Bane — break loose at normal size around a spilled crate of green Titan-serum injectors.
captions: Arkham Asylum. Tonight, every cage opened at once.
panels.notes: Cold-open establishing. Villains at BASELINE size here (tier 1) — the serum power-up happens across p01-02..04. One of the permitted wide-establish anchors.

panels.action: The villains jam green Titan-serum injectors into their necks and arms — Bane and Joker in frame — tubes flooding with luminous green.
panels.notes: Establishes the Titan serum as the villains' power source. Villains still baseline (tier 1) at the moment of dosing.

panels.action: Extreme close-up on Killer Croc ALONE — his scaled green shoulder and arm violently exploding with new muscle mass, scales stretching, glowing green Titan-serum veins lighting up under the surface as he swells much larger. Single figure only, no other character in frame.
panels.notes: Villain size-increase beat, SINGLE villain (Croc) to avoid character-fusion. Scarecrow/Joker growth covered collectively in p01-04. No-fusion rule.

panels.action: All four villains rise enormous against the strobing corridor — Croc, Scarecrow, Joker, Bane, now titan-sized — dwarfing the blown-out doorways behind them.
captions: They had the serum. All of them. It made them giants.
panels.notes: Closes the cold open: all four villains now tier 6. Establishes the size jump the serum causes. Low-angle-back for menace.

panels.action: Batman stands before the curved monitor array of the Batcave, one hand on the console, screens glowing cold blue across his cowl.
panels.notes: Establishes the Batcave and Batman baseline (tier 1). Location change — kept to medium per L20 distance budget.

panels.action: Profile of Batman's cowl underlit by the screen, a comm indicator blinking at the edge of frame as the call comes in.

dialogue.text: Bruce — Arkham's gone. They're all juiced on Titan.

panels.notes: Nightwing's call is off-panel dialogue — he is not in frame yet.

panels.action: Over Batman's shoulder at the monitor: a live feed of Arkham in flames and readouts on each escaped inmate.

dialogue.text: I'm en route. Don't go in alone.

panels.notes: Over-shoulder gives a reverse on the lobby/exterior we'll visit — shot-reverse hint for env reverse ref.

panels.action: Batman turns from the screen, jaw set, decision already made.

dialogue.text: They won't fit through the door if I wait.

panels.notes: Character beat. Low-angle-front for resolve.

panels.action: Batman opens a secure case on the console; the experimental serum auto-injector glows amber on its stand.
panels.notes: Introduces the experimental-serum prop. High-angle on the case.

panels.action: A gloved hand closes around the glowing amber vial, lifting it from the case.
captions: An experimental dose. His own work. Never tested on a human.
panels.notes: ecu-region on the prop. Caption carries the stakes.

panels.action: Batman pockets the vial in his belt, cape sweeping, and strides toward the waiting batmobile.
panels.notes: Full-body hero beat. Front-full at low angle.

panels.action: The batmobile tears down a rain-slick Gotham street, neon smearing past, the orange glow of burning Arkham ahead.
panels.notes: Batmobile prop in motion. Dutch for speed/tension. gotham-road is a one-off location (no ref_folder).

panels.action: Inside the cockpit, Batman's face underlit by the dash, the glowing vial resting on the seat beside him.
panels.notes: Cockpit interior. Keeps the serum visible as Chekhov's prop.

panels.action: High angle as the batmobile crosses the bridge toward the burning island silhouette.
panels.notes: Transitional. High-angle bridge crossing.

panels.action: The Arkham facade is engulfed in flames against the moon; the batmobile skids to a stop at the foot of the steps.
panels.notes: Essential establishing of arkham-exterior on fire. One of three permitted wide-establish anchors.

panels.action: Batman steps out of the batmobile, silhouetted against the wall of fire.
panels.notes: Hero entrance against fire.

panels.action: From behind, Batman strides through the broken front doors into the burning interior glow.
panels.notes: Threshold beat into the lobby. Three-quarter rear framing.

panels.action: The burning grand hall: four enormous Titan-juiced villains — Killer Croc, Scarecrow, Joker, Bane — loom on and around the grand staircase. Batman stands small in the foreground for scale.
panels.notes: Splash reveal of the four titan villains — the central threat. Scale via small foreground Batman. Only cast in frame (no extras, per house rule).

panels.action: Close on titan Joker's enormous grin, firelight dancing across chalk-white skin.

dialogue.text: Look who's late to his own funeral!

panels.notes: Dutch MCU for menace + a money face on a villain.

panels.action: Titan Bane charges, fist cocked back, as Batman braces low.
panels.notes: Beatdown begins. Batman still tier 1 here (outmatched).

panels.action: Batman is flung backward into a stone column, body folding around the impact.
panels.notes: tier on this panel = Batman (1). Dutch sells the hit.

panels.action: ECU of Batman's face, teeth gritted, blood at the corner of his mouth.
panels.notes: ECU money-face for the low point. High-angle = vulnerability.

panels.action: Batman on one knee, the titan villains closing in around him from above.
captions: He couldn't win this as a man.
panels.notes: High-angle defeat framing. Sets up the transformation choice.

panels.action: Down on one knee, Batman pulls the glowing amber injector from his belt and looks at it.
panels.notes: TRANSFORM 1 setup. Prop in hand.

panels.action: ECU on Batman's eyes — the decision lands, hard.
panels.notes: Decide beat. Face money-shot.

panels.action: Batman jams the injector into the side of his neck.
panels.notes: Trigger beat — the inciting moment.

panels.action: Batman's whole body tenses, amber-and-red energy crackling across the suit.
panels.notes: First-sensation beat.

panels.action: Crop on the chest: the armored plate strains and creaks as the pectorals swell beneath it.
panels.notes: Chest body-region beat. Landscape crop so the chest reads across the page.

panels.action: Crop on the arm: biceps balloon, the gauntlet fins popping loose as the forearm thickens.
panels.notes: Arms body-region beat. Tight crop (≤ mcu ceiling).

panels.action: Crop on the torso: abdominal plates broadening and ridging as the core packs on mass.
panels.notes: Abs body-region beat. Landscape crop.

panels.action: Batman throws his head back mid-roar, jaw bared, body now hugely muscled.
panels.notes: Face reaction intercut so the ECU run isn't faceless (L35). whole_body beat.

panels.action: The cape tears free at the shoulders and back seams burst as the frame widens. Coverage holds.
panels.notes: suit_fail beat. Kept at mcu (must stay tighter than full for body-region HARD ceiling).

panels.action: TITAN BATMAN revealed at full height, now matching the villains' scale, Bane recoiling at the edge of frame.
panels.notes: Reveal beat — full-body, close to camera, the payoff. Reveal exempt from the per-beat distance ceiling.

panels.action: Titan Batman drives Bane through a stone wall, debris exploding outward across the hall.
panels.notes: Re-establishes the lobby mid-fight (wide anchor for the back half). Batman now tier 6.

panels.action: Batman grabs Killer Croc by the jaw and slams him down onto the marble.
panels.notes: Solo focus on Croc here.

panels.action: ECU on titan Joker, grin faltering for the first time.
panels.notes: Villain reaction money-face; tonal beat.

panels.action: Batman backhands Joker the length of the hall.
panels.notes: Payoff to p10-03.

panels.action: Three villains sprawled in the rubble; titan Batman stands over them, breathing hard.
panels.notes: Beat of dominance before the turn. High-angle on the downed villains.

panels.action: Last one standing, titan Scarecrow rips a gas pod from his fear-toxin gauntlet.
panels.notes: Turns the fight. Solo focus on Scarecrow.

panels.action: A billowing wall of fear-toxin gas floods the hall and swallows Batman whole.
panels.notes: Gas event. Dutch + smoke.

panels.action: ECU: Batman's eyes flare blood-red, pupils blown, veins standing out — the toxin and the serum collide.
panels.notes: Rampancy onset. The red-eye ECU money-shot.

panels.action: Titan Batman roars, feral, fists clenched, no recognition left in his face.
captions: The serum and the toxin. A mind on fire.
panels.notes: Rampancy locked in. Sets up Nightwing's arrival.

panels.action: Nightwing swings in through a shattered upper window into the smoke, landing in a crouch.
panels.notes: Nightwing arrives at baseline (tier 1). High-angle entry.

panels.action: Hands raised, Nightwing edges toward the rampaging titan Batman.
panels.notes: The failed de-escalation. Two-shot with clear size disparity.

panels.action: ECU: Batman's red eyes, zero recognition — he sees only a target.
panels.notes: Beat that kills the hope of talking him down.

panels.action: Titan Batman swats Nightwing across the lobby like he weighs nothing.
panels.notes: Forces Nightwing's hand. Dutch sells the hit.

panels.action: Battered, Nightwing pushes up on one arm and spots the dropped amber injector glinting in the rubble.
panels.notes: TRANSFORM 2 setup (consider). The serum Batman dropped.

panels.action: Nightwing snatches the vial and jabs it into his arm, grimacing.
panels.notes: Trigger beat with a face (anchors the ECU run that follows).

panels.action: Crop on the chest and shoulders ballooning, the blue emblem stretching as the suit strains.
panels.notes: Chest body-region beat.

panels.action: Nightwing's face contorts mid-surge, teeth clenched, as the change rips through him.
panels.notes: Face reaction intercut inside the ECU run (L35). whole_body beat.

panels.action: Crop on the back broadening, the suit splitting down the spine seam.
panels.notes: Back body-region beat.

panels.action: Crop on the arms exploding in size, sleeves shredding off the forearms.
panels.notes: Arms body-region beat.

panels.action: TITAN NIGHTWING revealed at full height, matching Batman's scale, fists ready.
panels.notes: Reveal beat — full-body close payoff. Reveal exempt from per-beat ceiling.

panels.action: The two titans collide mid-hall, fists locked, neither giving ground.
panels.notes: Final clash opens. Both tier 6.

panels.action: Nightwing ducks a wild haymaker and drives a knee into Batman's ribs.
panels.notes: Nightwing technique vs Batman's blind rage.

panels.action: Nightwing forces Batman down and pins him, holding the bigger man against the floor.
panels.notes: The subdue.

panels.action: Pinned, Batman shrinks — the serum spent — de-transforming back to normal beneath Nightwing.
panels.notes: aftermath beat: Batman de-transforms (tier 6 -> tier 1). High-angle looking down on the shrinking figure.

panels.action: Exhausted, normal Bruce blinks up, the red gone from his eyes; titan Nightwing's hand rests on his shoulder.
captions: Dawn over Arkham. Two men — and one dose left to answer for.
panels.notes: Closing beat. Note Nightwing is still tier 6 here but the panel tier tag tracks Batman (1) for the de-transform continuity.

notes: DELIVERABLE: individual panel images only (58 panels) — do NOT compose pages or export a PDF (no page-composer). Villains also grow from the Titan serum: the cold open (p01-01..04) shows the four villains dosing and increasing from baseline (tier 1) to titan (tier 6) before they appear enormous in the lobby. Growth-page ratio: pages 8, 9, 13 are growth-active (3/14 = 21%) — below the transformation-chapter target because this is an ACTION chapter with two contained transformations, not a growth-focused issue; flagged intentionally per L35. Escalation devices in play: sfx-driven, clothing-destruction, full-body-reveal, reaction-intercut, size-comparison (small-foreground-Batman in p06-01, titan-scale reveals). Camera kept tight (chapter mean ~2.5) per L20 because transformation_scenes is declared; wide-establish reserved for the three location anchors (p01-01, p05-01, p10-01) + splash reveal (p06-01).
